correctness.rationale: Proof establishes simple full spectrum by reflection and an irreducible tridiagonal even block, with disjoint odd/even eigenvalues. All invisible even modes reduce exactly to odd Dirichlet sine indices and a two-equation root/leaf determinant; construction proves sufficiency. The PBH rank formula and both integer-congruence exceptional cases follow. A standalone verifier passed 322 full rational-weight Krylov-rank comparisons over two primes, 785 explicitly constructed eigenvector residuals, and 196 size-congruence checks. The finite tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural single-actuator design problem on the one-leaf perturbation of a cycle, with a complete exact positive-conductance resonance set. It distinguishes generic fixed-Laplacian controllability from exceptional exact-weight losses and provides two infinite periodic rank-defect families, not an unmotivated finite table or direct rewording of PBH.
